_meta.source: Economic Census 2013 via SHRUG v2.2 (ec13_shrid.csv), households from Mission Antyodaya (antyodaya_shrid.csv)
_meta.note: Real observations. Block = PC11 subdistrict, aggregated from village-level rows.
_meta.universe: rural shrids only (ec13r_shrid_key.csv); blocks with at least 100 households

category_mapping.dairy: Code 7 is literally 'Dairy'. Exact match, no interpretation needed.
category_mapping.flour_mill: Code 8 is 'Grain milling and grain products' — precisely what an atta chakki does. Exact match.
category_mapping.kirana: 47 'Retail of food, beverages, and tobacco' plus 49 'Retail in non-specialized stores'. A kirana is by definition non-specialized food retail. 48 'Retail in specialized stores' is excluded: a specialist shop is not a kirana and including it would inflate the competitor count.
category_mapping.tailoring: 14 'Manufacturing of clothing' is the core of a made-to-order village tailor. 50 'Repair of personal goods, finishing of textiles, preparation of textile fiber' covers the alteration and repair work that makes up the rest of the trade.

_meta.method_note: 'all' is the observed EC13 establishment count. Per-category figures are apportioned as count_all x (emp_shric_category / emp_all): EC13 publishes establishment counts only in total, so a category count is an estimate derived from that category's employment share, not an observed count.
